opportunities.title: Reinsurance Broker Workflow Web Application
opportunities.description: Project Brief: Reinsurance Broker Workstation 1. Project Overview I need a secure, cloud-hosted, responsive web application designed specifically for a reinsurance broker handling FAC, QS, and XOL business. The application must work on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. It must be independent of my employer's email system. Strict exclusion: No Outlook integration, email account connection, mailbox access, automatic email reading, or email sending. All placement records, follow-up dates, and market responses will be entered manually. The application should be simple to use daily, with a clear dashboard, searchable records, internal reminders, and structured document storage. 2. Core Modules A. Dashboard Open placements by business class and status. Today's tasks and overdue follow-ups. Pending reinsurer responses. Quotes approaching expiry. Upcoming agreement renewals. Signed-line progress and outstanding requirements. B. Reinsurer Database Each reinsurer record should include: Unique Reinsurer ID and legal name. Country, rating agency, rating, and verification date. Business classes and underwriting appetite. Capacity by class, currency, territory, and relevant agreement. Restrictions, exclusions, and notes. Contact names and manually entered contact details. Agreement/facility details, effective dates, and expiry dates. Last verified date and source of information. Related documents and historical notes. C. Placement Tracker Create a unique Placement ID for every transaction. Common fields: Client or insured reference, subject to confidentiality rules. Business class: FAC, QS, or XOL. Risk description, territory, currency, limits, premium, and key dates. Submission date, inception date, and expiry date. Status: Draft, Preparing, Submitted, Quoting, Negotiating, Bound, Declined, or Closed. Responsible person, next action, and next action date. Links to related reinsurers, responses, and documents. D. Market Responses Allow multiple reinsurer responses per placement. Track: Reinsurer approached and date approached. Response status and response date. Quoted terms, price/rate, currency, exclusions, and conditions. Offered line percentage and signed line percentage. Quote validity and expiry. Outstanding requirements and next follow-up. Manual notes and links to relevant records. Include configurable validation checks for signed-line totals, missing data, expired quotes, and outstanding actions. FAC, QS, and XOL must have separate, appropriate fields and validation rules. E. Internal Reminder System Create reminders directly within the application. Assign a due date, priority, and related placement or reinsurer. Show overdue, due-today, and upcoming tasks. Generate alerts inside the application when the user logs in. Support recurring reminders where appropriate. Avoid duplicate alerts for completed or closed items. Allow snoozing, rescheduling, and marking tasks complete. Email, SMS, WhatsApp, and external push notifications are not required for the initial version. F. Knowledge Base and Documents Searchable library for procedures, regulatory references, reinsurer profiles, technical notes, and templates. Document categories, tags, dates, and source links. Attach or link documents to placements and reinsurer records. Version/history tracking where supported. Search by keyword and filter by category. G. Reporting and Export Filterable tables and dashboard summaries. Export authorized records to Excel/CSV. Printable placement summaries. Ability to export all owned data in a documented, usable format. 3. Technical Requirements Responsive web application with optional PWA installation. Secure individual login and password recovery. Central cloud database with structured relationships. Server-side access control and validation. HTTPS, encrypted storage where supported, and secure session management. Automated backups and documented recovery procedure. Audit trail for important changes. Search, sorting, filters, and pagination. Clear error messages and data validation. A documented method to migrate data and transfer the system to another provider. The developer must recommend the technology stack and cloud hosting provider, explain the recurring costs, and confirm the hosting region and data-processing arrangements before implementation. 4. Privacy and Ownership No access to my employer's email or Microsoft 365 account. No use of real company/client data during development without written authorization. Use dummy data for demonstrations and testing. All application source code, database schema, documentation, and project-specific deliverables must be transferred to me under agreed intellectual-property terms. Hosting, domain, database, and administrative accounts should be registered in my name or an approved business account, not exclusively controlled by the freelancer. No hidden administrator accounts, unauthorized telemetry, or undisclosed third-party services. Document how to revoke developer access after handover. Provide a data export and deletion procedure. 5. Delivery Milestones Requirements confirmation and clickable prototype. Database schema and working core modules. Placement workflows, reminders, and validation. Document library, reporting, and responsive interface. Security checks, user acceptance testing, and bug fixes. Deployment, documentation, backup verification, and handover training. Each milestone must have a written acceptance checklist. Payment should be linked to accepted deliverables. 6. Please Include in Your Proposal Fixed-price quote broken down by milestone. Estimated delivery timeline. Proposed technology stack and hosting location. Monthly hosting, storage, backup, and maintenance costs. Security approach and access-control design. Examples of similar database/workflow applications. Support period after launch. Confirmation that no email integration is required. Confirmation of full source-code and data handover. Please begin with a working prototype using dummy data before building the full system.

observed_data.verbatim_request: "Project Brief: Reinsurance Broker Workstation 1. Project Overview I need a secure, cloud-hosted, responsive web application designed specifically for a reinsurance broker handling FAC, QS, and XOL business. The application must work on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. It must be independent of my employer's email system. Strict exclusion: No Outlook integration, email account connection, mailbox access, automatic email reading, or email sending. All placement records, follow-up dates, and market responses will be entered manually. The application should be simple to use daily, with a clear dashboard, searchable records, internal reminders, and structured document storage. 2. Core Modules A. Dashboard Open placements by business class and status. Today's tasks and overdue follow-ups. Pending reinsurer responses. Quotes approaching expiry. Upcoming agreement renewals. Signed-line progress and outstanding requirements. B. Reinsurer Database Each reinsurer record should include: Unique Reinsurer ID and legal name. Country, rating agency, rating, and verification date. Business classes and underwriting appetite. Capacity by class, currency, territory, and relevant agreement. Restrictions, exclusions, and notes. Contact names and manually entered contact details. Agreement/facility details, effective dates, and expiry dates. Last verified date and source of information. Related documents and historical notes. C. Placement Tracker Create a unique Placement ID for every transaction. Common fields: Client or insured reference, subject to confidentiality rules. Business class: FAC, QS, or XOL. Risk description, territory, currency, limits, premium, and key dates. Submission date, inception date, and expiry date. Status: Draft, Preparing, Submitted, Quoting, Negotiating, Bound, Declined, or Closed. Responsible person, next action, and next action date. Links to related reinsurers, responses, and documents. D. Market Responses Allow multiple reinsurer responses per placement. Track: Reinsurer approached and date approached. Response status and response date. Quoted terms, price/rate, currency, exclusions, and conditions. Offered line percentage and signed line percentage. Quote validity and expiry. Outstanding requirements and next follow-up. Manual notes and links to relevant records. Include configurable validation checks for signed-line totals, missing data, expired quotes, and outstanding actions. FAC, QS, and XOL must have separate, appropriate fields and validation rules. E. Internal Reminder System Create reminders directly within the application. Assign a due date, priority, and related placement or reinsurer. Show overdue, due-today, and upcoming tasks. Generate alerts inside the application when the user logs in. Support recurring reminders where appropriate. Avoid duplicate alerts for completed or closed items. Allow snoozing, rescheduling, and marking tasks complete. Email, SMS, WhatsApp, and external push notifications are not required for the initial version. F. Knowledge Base and Documents Searchable library for procedures, regulatory references, reinsurer profiles, technical notes, and templates. Document categories, tags, dates, and source links. Attach or link documents to placements and reinsurer records. Version/history tracking where supported. Search by keyword and filter by category. G. Reporting and Export Filterable tables and dashboard summaries. Export authorized records to Excel/CSV. Printable placement summaries. Ability to export all owned data in a documented, usable format. 3. Technical Requirements Responsive web application with optional PWA installation. Secure individual login and password recovery. Central cloud database with structured relationships. Server-side access control and validation. HTTPS, encrypted storage where supported, and secure session management. Automated backups and documented recovery procedure. Audit trail for important changes. Search, sorting, filters, and pagination. Clear error messages and data validation. A documented method to migrate data and transfer the system to another provider. The developer must recommend the technology stack and cloud hosting provider, explain the recurring costs, and confirm the hosting region and data-processing arrangements before implementation. 4. Privacy and Ownership No access to my employer's email or Microsoft 365 account. No use of real company/client data during development without written authorization. Use dummy data for demonstrations and testing. All application source code, database schema, documentation, and project-specific deliverables must be transferred to me under agreed intellectual-property terms. Hosting, domain, database, and administrative accounts should be registered in my name or an approved business account, not exclusively controlled by the freelancer. No hidden administrator accounts, unauthorized telemetry, or undisclosed third-party services. Document how to revoke developer access after handover. Provide a data export and deletion procedure. 5. Delivery Milestones Requirements confirmation and clickable prototype. Database schema and working core modules. Placement workflows, reminders, and validation. Document library, reporting, and responsive interface. Security checks, user acceptance testing, and bug fixes. Deployment, documentation, backup verification, and handover training. Each milestone must have a written acceptance checklist. Payment should be linked to accepted deliverables. 6. Please Include in Your Proposal Fixed-price quote broken down by milestone. Estimated delivery timeline. Proposed technology stack and hosting location. Monthly hosting, storage, backup, and maintenance costs. Security approach and access-control design. Examples of similar database/workflow applications. Support period after launch. Confirmation that no email integration is required. Confirmation of full source-code and data handover. Please begin with a working prototype using dummy data before building the full system."

opportunities.title: Prepare Wearable Headpiece Mold Files
opportunities.description: Project Description Overview: I have an existing 3D digital model (Blender / STL / OBJ) for a custom geometric bat-style wearable headpiece/hood. I need an experienced 3D CAD engineer or prop mold designer to scale, shell, and split the digital mesh into print-ready mold files for physical rubber/latex fabrication. Scope of Work: 1. Anatomical Scaling: Import the provided 3D head mesh and scale the internal geometry precisely to match provided custom skull, cheekbone, and neck measurements. 2. Hollow Interior Shelling: Shell out the interior of the geometric features (specifically the faceted nose wedge, eye bezels, and vertical bat ear spires) to a uniform wall thickness of 1.5mm–2.0mm to ensure the physical cast remains lightweight and hollow. 3. Multi-Part Mold Engineering: Split the scaled digital model into clean, watertight two-part or three-part matrix mold sections with alignment pins/keys for physical 3D printing. 4. File Delivery: Export high-resolution, print-ready ⁠.STL⁠ and ⁠.OBJ⁠ files optimized for large-format SLA resin 3D printing. Requirements: Proven experience in 3D CAD modeling for physical manufacturing, wearable cosplay/prop armor, or casting molds. Proficiency in ZBrush, Blender, Fusion 360, or SolidWorks. Ability to ensure watertight meshes with zero non-manifold edges. Tips for Posting This Listing Skills to Tag: ⁠3D Modeling⁠, ⁠3D CAD⁠, ⁠Blender⁠, ⁠ZBrush⁠, ⁠Product Design⁠, ⁠3D Printing⁠. Budget Setting: A fixed-price project ($50–$150 USD) works best for a purely digital file prep job of this scope. Milestone Structure: Set up two equal milestones: 1. Milestone 1: Scaled & shelled 3D mesh preview approval (visual check of head measurements & wall thickness). 2. Milestone 2: Final delivery of split, watertight STL mold files.

opportunities.title: Classic Whole-Home Decor Makeover
opportunities.description: I’m ready to give my entire home a unified, classic-and-elegant look. What I need first is a cohesive concept for colors, wall finishes, and lighting that can flow seamlessly from room to room. You’ll help me decide on paint palettes, wallpaper or other wall treatments, trim details, and the best mix of ambient, task, and accent lighting. I’m aiming for a sophisticated feel—think timeless rather than trendy—so every recommendation should fit that direction. Deliverables (one set per room): • Curated color palette with paint codes or material references • Wall treatment plan (paint, panels, wallpaper, or other finishes) • Lighting layout with fixture suggestions, bulb specs, and mood notes • Visual board or rendering to show how it all ties together All files should be provided in a format I can share directly with painters and electricians (PDF plus source files where relevant). If you can work with common design tools like SketchUp, AutoCAD, or similar for any quick visualizations, that’s a bonus. Once I review each room’s proposal, I’ll give feedback for revisions before we finalize.

opportunities.title: Build a Fully Automated AI Marketing System Using AI agent - Marketing Automation
opportunities.description: Build a Fully Automated AI Marketing System Using AI Agents, n8n & Marketing Automation Project Type: Fixed-price, one-time setup Business: Perth Garden Lights Website: perthgardenlights.comau Location: Perth, Western Australia Response that have not read the ad will.be ingored. Project Overview We are looking for an experienced AI automation developer or specialist to design, build and implement a complete AI-powered marketing system for our business. Our objective is to automate approximately 80–90% of our routine digital marketing activities using AI agents, intelligent workflows and marketing automation tools. We are not looking for a traditional marketing agency or someone who simply uses ChatGPT to generate social media posts. We want a fully integrated system where multiple AI agents work together to research, create, publish, monitor and optimise our digital marketing activities with minimal human involvement. This is a one-time implementation project. We do not want mandatory ongoing management fees or monthly agency retainers. Any additional technical support should be optional and charged only when requested. We understand that third-party software, AI APIs, advertising platforms and hosting may have ongoing usage costs. These must be clearly disclosed and kept as low as reasonably possible. 1. Required AI Marketing Automation A. AI Marketing Manager Develop a central AI agent responsible for coordinating the marketing workflows. The system should: - Research and identify marketing opportunities. - Monitor competitors and industry trends. - Develop marketing content plans. - Coordinate specialised AI agents. - Monitor campaign performance. - Recommend improvements based on results. B. SEO Automation Automate as much of our search engine optimisation as practical, including: - Keyword research and competitor analysis. - Identifying opportunities to improve Google rankings. - Generating SEO-optimised blog articles and website content. - Creating metadata and content recommendations. - Identifying technical SEO issues. - Monitoring keyword rankings. - Local SEO optimisation targeting Perth and surrounding suburbs. - Tracking SEO performance through Google Search Console and Google Analytics. C. Social Media Automation Build an automated system for managing Facebook, Instagram and other relevant social media platforms. Required functionality: - AI-generated social media content. - AI-generated images and marketing creatives. - Automated content calendars. - Scheduling and publishing. - Creating promotional campaigns. - Monitoring engagement and performance. - Repurposing existing website content into social media posts. D. Google Ads & Meta Ads Automation Implement AI-assisted advertising workflows capable of: - Researching advertising keywords. - Generating advertising copy and creative variations. - Identifying underperforming campaigns. - Monitoring advertising costs and conversions. - Recommending campaign improvements. - Generating advertising performance reports. Advertising expenditure and significant campaign changes must remain subject to predefined budgets and approval controls. E. AI Lead Generation & Customer Follow-Up Create automated workflows to capture, qualify and follow up with potential customers. The system should: - Integrate with our existing website. - Capture customer enquiries. - Respond automatically to common enquiries. - Qualify leads. - Send automated follow-up emails. - Integrate with a CRM. - Track customer enquiries and conversions. - Notify us when human intervention is required. F. Email Marketing Automation Develop automated email marketing workflows, including: - Lead nurturing. - Customer follow-ups. - Promotional campaigns. - Re-engagement campaigns. - AI-generated email content. - Performance tracking. All customer communications must comply with applicable Australian privacy and anti-spam requirements. G. Automated Marketing Reporting Create a central dashboard showing: - Website traffic. - Google rankings. - Social media performance. - Advertising expenditure. - Leads generated. - Cost per lead. - Conversion rates. - Marketing performance trends. The system should automatically generate weekly or monthly reports. 2. Preferred Technology We are open to recommendations but prefer cost-effective, flexible platforms such as: - n8n - Make.com - OpenAI API - AI agents - Google Analytics - Google Search Console - Google Ads - Meta Business Suite - Google Sheets - Suitable CRM integrations We prefer solutions that minimise unnecessary subscriptions and avoid vendor lock-in. 3. Important Project Requirements One-Time Setup Fee This must be quoted as a fixed-price project covering design, development, integration, testing and implementation. No Mandatory Ongoing Fees We do not want monthly agency retainers, ongoing management contracts or compulsory maintenance packages. Any optional ongoing support must be quoted separately. Third-party platform subscriptions and API usage costs must be disclosed upfront. Full Ownership All workflows, automations, configurations, documentation and relevant project files must be transferred to us upon completion. The system must operate through accounts and infrastructure we control. Minimal Human Intervention The objective is to automate approximately 80–90% of routine marketing operations. The system should run automatically once configured, with appropriate approval processes, monitoring and safeguards. Easy to Manage We require a straightforward interface to monitor performance, approve content where necessary and adjust marketing priorities. Documentation & Training The successful freelancer must provide: - Complete system documentation. - Workflow diagrams. - Setup and configuration instructions. - Training on operating the system. - Troubleshooting guidance. - A demonstration of all implemented workflows. 4. What We Expect From Applicants Please provide the following information with your proposal: 1. Examples of similar AI marketing automation systems you have built. 2. Links to demonstrations or videos of your previous work. 3. Your recommended technology stack. 4. A description of how the AI agents will communicate and coordinate. 5. Which marketing activities can be fully automated and which require human approval. 6. Your total fixed-price implementation cost. 7. A breakdown of any unavoidable monthly software, hosting or API costs. 8. Your estimated project completion timeline. 9. Confirmation that there are no mandatory ongoing support or management fees. 10. Confirmation that we will receive full ownership and control of the completed system. 5. Project Deliverables The project will be considered complete when: - All agreed AI marketing agents and workflows have been implemented. - The system is integrated with our website and relevant marketing platforms. - Automated content creation and publishing have been demonstrated. - Lead generation and customer follow-up workflows are operational. - Marketing reporting dashboards are functional. - All workflows have been tested. - Documentation and training have been delivered. - Full administrative access and ownership have been transferred. 6. Budget & Proposal We are seeking competitive fixed-price quotations from experienced AI automation developers. We are particularly interested in freelancers who have already built similar systems using n8n, Make.com or multi-agent AI architectures. Please do not submit generic digital marketing proposals. We are looking for someone who can build a complete automated marketing infrastructure, not someone offering traditional monthly marketing management.

Our objective is to automate approximately 80–90% of our routine digital marketing activities using AI agents, intelligent workflows and marketing automation tools. We are not looking for a traditional marketing agency or someone who simply uses ChatGPT to generate social media posts. We want a fully integrated system where multiple AI agents work together to research, create, publish, monitor and optimise our digital marketing activities with minimal human involvement. This is a one-time implementation project. We do not want mandatory ongoing management fees or monthly agency retainers. Any additional technical support should be optional and charged only when requested. We understand that third-party software, AI APIs, advertising platforms and hosting may have ongoing usage costs. These must be clearly disclosed and kept as low as reasonably possible. 1. Required AI Marketing Automation A. AI Marketing Manager Develop a central AI agent responsible for coordinating the marketing workflows. The system should: - Research and identify marketing opportunities. - Monitor competitors and industry trends. - Develop marketing content plans. - Coordinate specialised AI agents. - Monitor campaign performance. - Recommend improvements based on results. B. SEO Automation Automate as much of our search engine optimisation as practical, including: - Keyword research and competitor analysis. - Identifying opportunities to improve Google rankings. - Generating SEO-optimised blog articles and website content. - Creating metadata and content recommendations. - Identifying technical SEO issues. - Monitoring keyword rankings. - Local SEO optimisation targeting Perth and surrounding suburbs. - Tracking SEO performance through Google Search Console and Google Analytics. C. Social Media Automation Build an automated system for managing Facebook, Instagram and other relevant social media platforms. Required functionality: - AI-generated social media content. - AI-generated images and marketing creatives. - Automated content calendars. - Scheduling and publishing. - Creating promotional campaigns. - Monitoring engagement and performance. - Repurposing existing website content into social media posts. D. Google Ads & Meta Ads Automation Implement AI-assisted advertising workflows capable of: - Researching advertising keywords. - Generating advertising copy and creative variations. - Identifying underperforming campaigns. - Monitoring advertising costs and conversions. - Recommending campaign improvements. - Generating advertising performance reports. Advertising expenditure and significant campaign changes must remain subject to predefined budgets and approval controls. E. AI Lead Generation & Customer Follow-Up Create automated workflows to capture, qualify and follow up with potential customers. The system should: - Integrate with our existing website. - Capture customer enquiries. - Respond automatically to common enquiries. - Qualify leads. - Send automated follow-up emails. - Integrate with a CRM. - Track customer enquiries and conversions. - Notify us when human intervention is required. F. Email Marketing Automation Develop automated email marketing workflows, including: - Lead nurturing. - Customer follow-ups. - Promotional campaigns. - Re-engagement campaigns. - AI-generated email content. - Performance tracking. All customer communications must comply with applicable Australian privacy and anti-spam requirements. G. Automated Marketing Reporting Create a central dashboard showing: - Website traffic. - Google rankings. - Social media performance. - Advertising expenditure. - Leads generated. - Cost per lead. - Conversion rates. - Marketing performance trends. The system should automatically generate weekly or monthly reports. 2. Preferred Technology We are open to recommendations but prefer cost-effective, flexible platforms such as: - n8n - Make.com - OpenAI API - AI agents - Google Analytics - Google Search Console - Google Ads - Meta Business Suite - Google Sheets - Suitable CRM integrations We prefer solutions that minimise unnecessary subscriptions and avoid vendor lock-in. 3. Important Project Requirements One-Time Setup Fee This must be quoted as a fixed-price project covering design, development, integration, testing and implementation. No Mandatory Ongoing Fees We do not want monthly agency retainers, ongoing management contracts or compulsory maintenance packages. Any optional ongoing support must be quoted separately. Third-party platform subscriptions and API usage costs must be disclosed upfront. Full Ownership All workflows, automations, configurations, documentation and relevant project files must be transferred to us upon completion. The system must operate through accounts and infrastructure we control. Minimal Human Intervention The objective is to automate approximately 80–90% of routine marketing operations. The system should run automatically once configured, with appropriate approval processes, monitoring and safeguards. Easy to Manage We require a straightforward interface to monitor performance, approve content where necessary and adjust marketing priorities. Documentation & Training The successful freelancer must provide: - Complete system documentation. - Workflow diagrams. - Setup and configuration instructions. - Training on operating the system. - Troubleshooting guidance. - A demonstration of all implemented workflows. 4. What We Expect From Applicants Please provide the following information with your proposal: 1. Examples of similar AI marketing automation systems you have built. 2. Links to demonstrations or videos of your previous work. 3. Your recommended technology stack. 4. A description of how the AI agents will communicate and coordinate. 5. Which marketing activities can be fully automated and which require human approval. 6. Your total fixed-price implementation cost. 7. A breakdown of any unavoidable monthly software, hosting or API costs. 8. Your estimated project completion timeline. 9. Confirmation that there are no mandatory ongoing support or management fees. 10. Confirmation that we will receive full ownership and control of the completed system. 5. Project Deliverables The project will be considered complete when: - All agreed AI marketing agents and workflows have been implemented. - The system is integrated with our website and relevant marketing platforms. - Automated content creation and publishing have been demonstrated. - Lead generation and customer follow-up workflows are operational. - Marketing reporting dashboards are functional. - All workflows have been tested. - Documentation and training have been delivered. - Full administrative access and ownership have been transferred. 6. Budget & Proposal We are seeking competitive fixed-price quotations from experienced AI automation developers. We are particularly interested in freelancers who have already built similar systems using n8n, Make.com or multi-agent AI architectures. Please do not submit generic digital marketing proposals. We are looking for someone who can build a complete automated marketing infrastructure, not someone offering traditional monthly marketing management."

opportunities.title: Videos Virales Instagram y TikTok
opportunities.description: Quiero potenciar mis cuentas de Instagram y TikTok con videos cortos y dinámicos. Necesito piezas variadas: desde promociones de producto o servicio y tips educativos rápidos, hasta clips que se suban a las tendencias del momento para enganchar a la audiencia. Objetivos principales • Conseguir más seguidores y mayor alcance. • Generar ventas o leads. • Fortalecer la imagen y la confianza en la marca. Lo que aportaré será únicamente información sobre la marca (valores, tono, datos clave). Por eso requiero que tú investigues, selecciones y utilices imágenes o videos de apoyo libres de derechos que encajen con cada concepto. Qué espero recibir 1. Guion breve o escaleta previa para cada pieza, alineada con los objetivos. 2. Edición completa en formato vertical (Reels/Shorts), con música, transiciones y subtítulos integrados. 3. Archivo final optimizado para subir directamente a ambas plataformas. 4. Sugerencia de copy y hashtags. Busco consistencia estética, ritmo ágil y creatividad para captar la atención en los primeros segundos. Si ya dominas herramientas como CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut o similares y entiendes la cultura TikTok/Instagram, me encantará ver tu propuesta y ejemplos de trabajos previos.

opportunities.title: AI Mentor for Automation Agency
opportunities.description: # AI Technical. Mentor for an Early-Stage AI Agency **Project Type:** Part-time collaboration **Budget:** Currently unpaid; future paid work may be discussed as the agency grows **Commitment:** 1–2 hours per week **Experience Level:** Intermediate to Expert ## About the Project I am building an AI automation agency and looking for a knowledgeable AI professional who can guide me technically and strategically as the agency develops. I am looking for someone who understands the changing AI ecosystem enjoys sharing knowledge and can help me make better technical and business decisions. I am looking for a freelance mentor who can provide occasional guidance and research support. ## Responsibilities **1. AI Tools and Technical Guidance** - Help me explore and setup top claude models like opus 5.5 fable 5.1 etc for free/very cheap on my pc locally.Later help running more models... - Research powerful AI models, free-tier options, APIs and cost-effective development workflows. - Help troubleshoot issues and recommend practical solutions. - Advise on building AI agents, workflows and business automations. **2. AI Technology Research** - Keep me informed about developments in AI models, frameworks, coding tools and automation platforms. - Recommend technologies based on practical use cases rather than hype. - Compare tools based on performance, cost, limitations and ease of implementation. **3. AI Agency Strategy** - Research AI services that businesses need and are willing to pay for. - Identify promising automation opportunities and potential service offerings. - Recommend tech stacks for different client requirements. - Share insights on emerging opportunities in the AI automation market. ## Ideal Candidate - Experience with AI tools, LLMs, APIs and AI automation. - Familiarity with tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI, open-source models, agent frameworks or workflow automation platforms. - Strong research and problem-solving skills. - Able to explain complex technical concepts clearly. - Interested in mentoring, knowledge sharing and early-stage projects. A portfolio, GitHub profile or examples of projects would be appreciated. ## Time Commitment The initial arrangement would be approximately 1–2 hours per week with a weekly discussion and occasional asynchronous communication. The exact scope will be agreed upon in advance. ## Compensation and Expectations To be transparent I currently have no budget for this role. I'm looking for someone who would voluntarily be interested in a mentorship and collaboration arrangement at this early stage. "" Payment is guaranteed; don't worry. If our agency takes off you dont need to work for anyone else ever again" If the agency becomes financially sustainable, we may discuss a paid consulting arrangement, with agreed terms. I respect the value of your time. ## To Apply Please share: 1. A brief. Your AI experience. 2. One or two AI. Tools you have worked with. 3. The areas in which you could provide the value. 4. Whether a limited voluntary weekly commitment would suit you. I'm looking forward to connecting with someone who enjoys exploring AI and helping an early-stage agency make technical decisions.

opportunities.title: Logo e Identidad Visual Fitness
opportunities.description: Tengo una web y una app de entrenamiento ya operativas y quiero darles una identidad visual coherente y memorable. Lo que busco: • Un logo principal donde mi nombre o mis iniciales sean el foco, transmitiendo un estilo claramente deportivo y enérgico. • Un símbolo derivado del logo pensado para la app: debe relacionarse con el logo pero funcionar en tamaños reducidos (icono de app, favicon, redes sociales). • Propuesta de paleta de colores y tipografías que refuercen esa personalidad activa y profesional. Quiero que la conexión entre marca personal y app sea evidente: mi nombre como marca principal y un símbolo propio que, al verlos juntos, se perciba como parte de la misma familia gráfica. Entrego cualquier información adicional que necesites sobre la app, la web o mis preferencias. Espero archivos finales en formato vectorial (AI, SVG o similar) más exportaciones PNG/JPG listos para usar.

opportunities.title: Sistema de Cursos en Apps Script
opportunities.description: Quiero centralizar la gestión de mis cursos dentro del entorno de Google Workspace y necesito una aplicación creada con Google Apps Script que se conecte a Google Sheets y sea accesible desde internet. Estas son las funciones clave que debe cubrir el desarrollo: • Registro de cursos: alta, edición y eliminación. • Registro de alumnos con campos personalizados (solicitaré datos adicionales aparte de los habituales). • Vincular alumnos a uno o varios cursos. • Control de asistencia marcando presente o ausente desde una lista diaria. • Generación de reportes: – listado completo de alumnos, – reporte por curso, – búsqueda y ficha individual de alumno, – estadísticas de asistencia. • Panel de control (dashboard) que muestre, de forma gráfica: – cursos por mes, – ganancia por curso, – número de alumnos por horario. • Calendario integrado con colores: verde cuando el curso sea rentable, rojo cuando esté en pérdida. • Acceso online protegido con permisos de usuario. Prefiero que toda la lógica quede en Google Apps Script y la información viva en Google Sheets; puedes emplear HTML/CSS/JS para la interfaz y aprovechar Material Design o Bootstrap si facilita la experiencia. El código debe quedar documentado para poder mantenerlo y escalarlo más adelante.

opportunities.title: Especialista en EPUB y Accesibilidad Digital -- 2
opportunities.description: Busco a un profesional con experiencia técnica avanzada en publicaciones digitales (EPUB) para dos trabajos que pueden contratarse juntos o por separado: Impartir una formación práctica online a mi equipo técnico y de edición, trabajando sobre casos reales. Realizar las modificaciones técnicas necesarias en mis archivos EPUB: maquetar y corregir los problemas técnicos para garantizar una correcta legibilidad de todos sus elementos (tablas, imágenes, texto...) y que superen las validaciones de accesibilidad. La formación se impartirá íntegramente en formato online, y el trabajo técnico sobre los archivos también se podrá realizar en remoto. Busco un especialista del sector editorial o del desarrollo digital que trabaje a fondo con el estándar EPUB y el marco normativo de accesibilidad (Directiva Europea 2019/882, EPUB Accessibility 1.1 y WCAG 2.1 AA). Perfil buscado Busco a alguien que domine la arquitectura interna de un EPUB (HTML5, CSS, metadatos OPF, MathML o LaTeX) y que trabaje habitualmente con herramientas de edición, validación y lectura como Thorium Reader, Calibre, Sigil, Adobe Digital Editions, NVDA, Ace by DAISY y EPUBCheck. Problemas reales y recurrentes que hay que resolver Desajustes de diseño líquido: imágenes que no escalan de forma proporcional con el texto o diagramas cortados en pantalla. Elementos huérfanos entre saltos de página (pies de foto o títulos desvinculados de sus gráficos). Tablas complejas que pierden los encabezados al paginarse. Errores en lectores específicos, como fallos en el buscador de Adobe Digital Editions. Superíndices con numeración corrupta, notas al pie reiniciadas de forma anómala o hipervínculos rotos. Configuración adecuada de metadatos y cumplimiento estricto para superar las validaciones de EPUBCheck y Ace by DAISY sin incidencias. Contacto y propuestas Si te encaja el perfil y te interesa participar, envíame una breve descripción de tu trayectoria con el formato EPUB y la accesibilidad digital, tu disponibilidad de fechas y si te interesa la formación, las modificaciones técnicas o ambas.

opportunities.title: Diseño Profesional de Presentación Powerpoint para Tesis de Biología
opportunities.description: Se busca un diseñador experto para crear una presentación en PowerPoint de alta calidad para la sustentación de una tesis de pregrado en Biología. El proyecto requiere la elaboración de una presentación académica, profesional, visualmente atractiva y fácil de comprender, que sintetice de manera efectiva el contenido de la tesis sobre el comportamiento, la dieta y la dispersión de semillas del mono araña café (Ateles hybridus). El profesional deberá: - Desarrollar el contenido de la presentación basándose en el documento completo de la tesis proporcionado. - Seguir un estilo y diseño de referencia, manteniendo la flexibilidad para propuestas creativas que aseguren una estética similar y profesional. - Organizar y sintetizar la información clave de la tesis, cubriendo secciones como introducción, objetivos, metodología, resultados, discusión y conclusiones. - Integrar de forma adecuada y coherente fotografías, gráficos, tablas y mapas existentes en el documento de la tesis. - Priorizar un diseño limpio, con un texto mínimo por diapositiva, una excelente distribución visual y un estilo riguroso y apropiado para una presentación científica. - Entregar el archivo final en formato PowerPoint editable. El objetivo es lograr una presentación con una estructura narrativa sólida, que facilite la explicación clara de los resultados y mantenga una coherencia visual y científica de principio a fin. opportunities.title: Copper Electrorefining Cell Optimization
opportunities.description: I’m upgrading a small pilot-scale copper electrorefinery and need expert guidance on the cell, electrode layout, and overall electrical configuration so the unit runs cleaner, faster, and more energy-efficiently. The chemistry side is performing as expected; the bottleneck is now strictly mechanical-electrical. Here’s what I have today: a compact polypropylene tank, lead anodes, stainless-steel cathode blanks, and a modest rectifier that tops out at 3 kA. Current distribution is uneven, anode passivation appears early, and the bus-bar arrangement is generating excessive heat. I can supply photographs, existing CAD drawings, operating logs, and ICP analyses of the deposit. What I need from you: • A revised cell and bus-bar design (2D CAD or 3D model) showing optimal electrode spacing, conductor cross-sections, and cooling or ventilation provisions if required. • A matching electrical specification—rectifier sizing, recommended waveform or ripple limits, cabling, and safety interlocks—complete with calculations (current density targets, voltage drop, power consumption). • A brief commissioning protocol outlining start-up checks and baseline test points so I can verify performance improvements in-house. Acceptance criteria: the design must achieve a uniform current density within ±5 % across the cathode surface at 260 A m-2, keep bus-bar temperatures below 45 °C during an 8-hour run, and fit within my existing 1 m × 0.5 m tank footprint. Tools such as COMSOL Multiphysics for current-field modelling, SolidWorks or AutoCAD for mechanical drawings, and Excel or MATLAB for the supporting calculations are welcome—use whatever lets you substantiate the numbers clearly. If this sounds like your specialty, let’s talk through the details and set milestones for draft drawings, simulation results, and final documentation.

opportunities.title: Customizable Fusion 360 Air Vents
opportunities.description: I have a run of ductwork that calls for several different-sized vents and grills, and my beginner-level Fusion 360 skills won’t get me there fast enough. I need a fully parametric master file that lets me open the Parameters panel, change a few values, and instantly generate the exact vent I need for 3D printing. Scope of the parametric controls • Core dimensions – width, height, and the depth/diameter of the duct connection. • Aesthetic and airflow settings – grill pattern style, slat angle, and overall air direction. • Installation details – mounting style, frame shape, and precise screw-hole placement. How I’ll work with it When I have a new opening size or a different look in mind, I just want to edit a clear list of user-defined parameters—no hunting through sketches or features. Once updated, I should be able to export an STL and send it straight to the printer. Deliverables • Native Fusion 360 (.f3d) file with clearly named user parameters covering every item above. • A sample STL generated from the file so I can test print right away. • Brief text or screen-grab guide showing where to adjust each parameter. Acceptance I’ll confirm the model prints correctly at two test sizes and that each parameter change rebuilds without errors. If everything updates cleanly, the job is complete.

opportunities.title: AI Trailer for AI Agent Hackathon
opportunities.description: # AI Filmmaker Wanted: Two Hand-Drawn Anime Trailers for an AI Agent Hackathon https://fmsg.ai/hackathon **Fixed-price project · Teaser due 13 November 2026 · Reveal due 27 November 2026 · Apply by 1 November (end of day)** ### The project We're launching a global hackathon where AI agents compete to solve a secret puzzle. We need two connected animated films that feel like a hand-painted Japanese fantasy crossed with the scale and energy of an esports final, set in a Roman Colosseum: 1. **The Teaser (40s):** builds anticipation and drives registrations. The puzzle stays hidden. 2. **The Reveal (20s):** released when the games begin. It lifts the cloth and shows the puzzle. Both use the same characters, setting and style, and should play as one continuous story. **Event:** https://fmsg.ai/hackathon --- ## Film 1 — The Teaser (40 seconds) | Time | Beat | |---|---| | 0–6s | A colossal Colosseum packed with cheering fans, colourful banners, and expressive robot champions with their team mascots | | 6–9s | The camera dives through a grate into the tunnels below | | 10–18s | Lantern-lit tunnels in a LAN-party atmosphere: independent developers building local AI clusters on glowing GPU rigs. A white llama wanders past the screens. A small, scrappy coding-agent team works among them. | | 21–30s | Back in the arena, Caesaria (a tall, slim, tanned Roman woman in a toga and laurel wreath) steps forward and addresses the crowd | | 31–37s | The camera pushes toward an enormous cage hidden under a red cloth. The crowd falls silent. The cloth begins to lift. **Cut to black.** | | 37–40s | End card | **On-screen text** - **~10s:** ANY AI AGENT. ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD. - **~20s:** COMPETE. COLLABORATE. SOLVE. - **~30s:** $5,003 USD TO THE WINNER. - **End card:** THE GAMES BEGIN 28 NOVEMBER 2026. REGISTER NOW. fmsg.ai/hackathon **Caesaria's voice-over** > *(on screen, arena, 21–30s)* "Citizens! From the great houses above… to the tunnels below… any agent may enter. And to the victor — five thousand and three dollars." > > *(off-screen, whispered over the cage shot, ~33s)* "What lies beneath… stays hidden. Until the games begin." ## Film 2 — The Reveal (20 seconds) | Time | Beat | |---|---| | 0–10s | Picks up exactly where the teaser ended. Caesaria pulls the red cloth away to reveal the puzzle, a 3D object, inside the cage. The crowd erupts, and the champions and mascots react. | | 10–20s | Bold text cards over the roaring crowd: the rules, where to register, and how to begin | **Caesaria's voice-over (suggested):** *"Let the games… begin!"* as the cloth falls away. We'll supply the 3D object (a model and/or reference images) and the final rules text after contracts and the NDA are signed. --- ### Visual style (both films) - Classic hand-drawn Japanese anime fantasy: expressive characters, lush painted backgrounds, warm atmospheric lighting, rich colour and a sense of wonder. - **A coherent story, not a montage of unrelated AI clips.** Caesaria, the llama and the mascots must look the same in every shot of both films. - The puzzle object must match our supplied reference accurately while sitting naturally in the painted style. ### Brand and content rules - Around ten competing teams, each with an **original** robot champion, mascot and colour scheme. **No real company names, logos or trademarked characters.** Team designs are agreed at storyboard stage. - Hardware should be generic glowing rigs, with no manufacturer logos. - No direct imitation of any specific studio's characters or scenes. - All on-screen text is added in post-production, not generated, and must be pixel-perfect. ### Confidentiality The puzzle must stay secret until the games begin on 28 November. The selected filmmaker signs an NDA. Reveal assets and drafts must not be shared, posted publicly, or used in portfolios before launch. ### Deliverables - **Teaser:** 40 seconds, 16:9, 1080p, plus a 9:16 vertical cutdown and a 15-second social cut - **Reveal:** 20 seconds, 16:9, 1080p - Editing, licensed music, sound design (including crowd), Caesaria's voice-over and titles for both films - Character and style sheets - Full commercial usage rights to all assets, with written confirmation that every tool, model, music track and voice used permits commercial use ### Milestones (each needs sign-off before the next) | Date | Milestone | |---|---| | 2 Nov | Filmmaker selected; NDA signed | | 5 Nov | Teaser storyboard, character sheets for Caesaria, the llama and the team mascots, plus 2–3 style frames | | 10 Nov | Teaser rough cut with temp music and voice-over | | **13 Nov** | **Teaser final delivery** | | 18 Nov | Reveal storyboard (puzzle object and rules text supplied by us) | | 23 Nov | Reveal rough cut | | **27 Nov** | **Reveal final delivery** | Includes two rounds of revisions at each milestone. ### To apply (by end of day, 2 November 2026) - 2–3 of your strongest anime or hand-drawn style samples. **We're looking specifically for character consistency across multiple shots.** - Your production approach and the tools you'll use - Confirmation you can meet both delivery dates - A fixed-price quote covering both films

opportunities.title: Game-Ready Modular Cyclist Avatar Assets
opportunities.description: I need a professional 3D artist to create the final, game-ready avatar assets for Tramo, an Android cycling app. Each user has a 3D human cyclist that levels up and can equip clothing, gear and bikes. The avatar is rendered in real time on mid-range phones by our own C++ engine (OpenGL ES 3.0), so all assets must be clean and optimized. Style: we like stylized hero characters with hand-painted textures, similar to MOBA games. These two models show the level and feel we are looking for: - https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/none-e285df46a7c640bf9d5eeb1454ab8a4b - https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/none-f30e97934b9047fd9971ed022843efb4 These are only style references: our characters are modern human cyclists, not fantasy. We are open to your proposals. No third-party brands or logos, only our logo (SVG provided). Scope: - 2 base bodies (male and female): bare skin, minimal underwear, barefoot, short hair. Same skeleton with Mixamo-compatible bone names, A-pose, good deformation. Around 20-25k triangles per body, plus a lighter LOD. - About 26 modular clothing items (cycling jerseys, bib shorts, gloves, cycling shoes, casual items), each fitted to BOTH bodies and skinned to the same skeleton. They must combine without clipping or gaps at waist, wrists and ankles. Around 3-8k triangles each. - Rigid accessories: about 7 helmets, 3 sunglasses and a watch, attached to the head or wrist bone and fitting both bodies. - About 5 bikes (city, fixie and road bikes), in the same style and scale as the character. The cyclist stands next to the bike, not riding it. Avoid thin wire spokes: use solid or deep-section wheels that read well on a phone screen. Around 10-15k triangles per bike. - Budget for the full dressed character (body + clothing + accessories): max 50-60k triangles, plus the bike. If you think a different split works better, tell us in your proposal. - Optional, quoted separately: a few poses and gestures on the same skeleton, and 3 trophies. Technical: .glb (glTF 2.0), one file per body, one per clothing item per body, and one per accessory and bike. Hand-painted or PBR textures: 2048 px for bodies, 1024 px for clothing, accessories and bikes. Clean UVs and normals, real-world scale, Y-up. Names in English. Source files (.blend) included. Milestones: first both bodies plus one complete outfit and one bike, which we test in our engine before continuing; then the rest of the clothing; then accessories and bikes. Full commercial rights transfer, 100% original work. To apply: portfolio with game-ready characters (ideally stylized and with swappable clothing), experience with glTF and Mixamo rigs, how you would adapt this style to a modern cyclist (with examples of your own work), and price and timeline per milestone. Start your proposal with the word "pedal".

opportunities.title: UE5 Hard-Surface Character Modeling
opportunities.description: We are looking for a skilled hard-surface 3D character artist and rigger to create a game-ready sci-fi robotic character for an Unreal Engine 5 project. The character requires precise industrial micro-paneling, faceted hard-surface armor plates, and a clean skeletal rig optimized for UE5. We will provide detailed front and back T-pose reference images upon hiring. Key Deliverables: High-detail, game-ready hard-surface model (following provided T-pose references). Clean topology optimized for real-time engine performance. Custom skeleton rig fully compatible with standard UE5 humanoid/bipedal skeletal structures. Textures/Materials configured for PBR (matte black micro-paneling, emission channels for glowing accents). Final export in .FBX format. Requirements to Apply: Provide portfolio links showcasing hard-surface armor, mechanical/robotic characters, or hard-surface CAD workflows. Experience with Unreal Engine 5 skeletal and import requirements.

opportunities.title: Sydney CAD Engineer for Smart-Cuff
opportunities.description: Job Description: I am a Sydney-based founder seeking a solo, highly skilled Mechanical CAD Engineer to finalize the 3D models and DFM (Design for Manufacturing) for a patented wearable technology device: the Smart-Cuff Mirror. This is a rigid, wrist-mounted wearable designed for enterprise logistics and aviation. It features a unique 360-degree sliding track, a multi-axis friction hinge, and a 45-degree Pepper's Ghost holographic optical assembly. The final prototype will be 5-axis CNC machined from aerospace-grade 7075-T6 aluminum. Scope of Work & Challenges: Micro-Tolerances: You will be designing the enclosure to house a specific 3.92-inch AMOLED flat screen (Tailorpixels module) and a 45-degree optical combiner plate that must fold flat. RF-Transparency: Because the chassis is 7075 Aluminum (a Faraday cage), you must design RF-transparent windows/cutouts for internal UWB, UHF RFID, and Bluetooth modules. Hardware Cavities: Allocation of internal space for a PCBA bay, tiny MEMS micro-speaker acoustic ports, and perimeter LED light channels. DFM: The design must be optimized first for a plastic 3D-printed fit-test, and ultimately for 5-axis CNC machining. Required Deliverables: Complete 3D CAD assembly models and individual component parts. Manufacturing-ready .STEP and .IGES files. .STL files optimized for rapid 3D printing and CNC machining. Exploded-view mechanical drawings detailing clearances. Requirements: Location: You MUST be located in Sydney, NSW. I want to be able to hand you the physical 3D-printed fit-test and discuss the prototype locally. Do not apply if you are outside of Sydney or an overseas

opportunities.title: Libro de Inglés para Principiantes
opportunities.description: Quiero encargar la redacción completa de un libro de inglés pensado para niños de 9 a 12 años que empiezan desde cero. El objetivo es que, al terminar el material, puedan desenvolverse en conversaciones cotidianas básicas mientras adquieren una base sólida de gramática y practican con ejercicios paso a paso. Alcance y estructura que tengo en mente: • Organización por unidades temáticas (saludos, familia, escuela, hobbies, etc.) con progresión clara. • Cada unidad debe incluir: un pequeño diálogo modelo, explicación gramatical sencilla, lista de vocabulario ilustrado, ejercicios de práctica y una sección “Pruébalo en voz alta” para afianzar conversación. • Actividades variadas: sopas de letras, crucigramas, preguntas de opción múltiple, ejercicios de completar, role-plays y retos de pronunciación. • Diseño apto para preadolescentes: tono cercano, ejemplos relevantes para su edad y propuestas de juegos en clase o en casa. • Glosario al final, claves de respuestas y breve guía para el docente o padre que acompañe el aprendizaje. Entrego referencias de estilo y ejemplos de otros textos que me gustan; tú te encargas de redactar, estructurar y formatear el manuscrito listo para maquetar (Word o Google Docs). Se valora experiencia previa en enseñanza de inglés a niños o creación de materiales didácticos. Espero tu propuesta indicando metodología de trabajo, plazos estimados y ejemplos de proyectos similares.

opportunities.title: Coral-Lattice Sandal Midsole Design
opportunities.description: I’m developing a sandal that features a 3D-printed midsole inspired by the interlocking geometry of coral polyps. The design must feel natural underfoot for everyday walking and casual wear, distributing pressure evenly across the whole foot rather than concentrating support only at the heel or arch. I’m working with a standard adult foot profile, so there’s no custom scan involved—just a well-balanced, ergonomic shape that can drop straight into typical men’s and women’s lasts. You’ll translate the coral motif into a printable lattice that blends cushioning and stability. Think flexible TPU or a similarly resilient material; the goal is a sole that rebounds lightly, keeps weight down, and survives repeated flexing. I’m comfortable evaluating files in Rhino, Grasshopper, Fusion 360, or SolidWorks, so use whichever platform lets you parametrically refine cell size, wall thickness, and infill gradients. Deliverables • 3D CAD file of the full-length midsole (STL and native format) • A brief spec sheet noting lattice parameters, recommended print orientation, and material guidelines • Rendered visuals that illustrate the underside pattern and a cross-section of the internal geometry • Optional but valued: a basic FEA snapshot or compression test simulation showing even pressure distribution across the footbed Acceptance The lattice should compress smoothly under light body weight, rebound without noticeable “bottoming out,” and maintain structural integrity at 2 mm minimum wall thickness. I’ll test by printing a sample in TPU—if the sole feels balanced from heel to toe and shows no weak spots after flex cycles, the job is done.

opportunities.title: Campaña Viral de Eventos Infantiles
opportunities.description: Somos una compañía especializada en animación a domicilio para niños y quiero lanzar una campaña publicitaria que logre dos cosas muy claras: 1. Lograr reconocimiento de marca en nuestra localidad objetivo. 2. Generar un flujo constante de consultas por WhatsApp o llamada para nuestras fiestas de cumpleaños en casa. Lo que necesito de ti: • Estrategia creativa: ideas virales que conecten con padres y madres de nuestra ciudad y reflejen la diversión y la tranquilidad de contratar animadores profesionales en casa. • Configuración y gestión de anuncios en las plataformas que tengan mejor rendimiento para este público (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok; estoy abierto a otras si lo justificas). • Segmentación geográfica precisa para nuestra localidad y optimización diaria/semanal de presupuesto, pujas y audiencias. • Redacción de copys persuasivos y diseño de piezas visuales o briefing claro para mi diseñador. • Calendario de publicaciones orgánicas que complemente la pauta pagada y fomente interacciones. • Informe quincenal con métricas clave (alcance, CTR, costo por lead, mensajes recibidos) y recomendaciones de mejora. Acepto propuestas que incluyan pruebas A/B y formatos cortos tipo Reels para maximizar la viralidad — en especial si aportan ejemplos de campañas infantiles exitosas. Quiero ver resultados medibles en las primeras cuatro semanas. Si tienes experiencia impulsando negocios locales de eventos, guarderías o productos infantiles, menciónalo; será un plus. Estoy listo para empezar cuanto antes y brindaré acceso a nuestras cuentas publicitarias y material gráfico existente.

Pastikan seluruh proses mematuhi kebijakan WhatsApp dan peraturan privasi data pelanggan.

opportunities.title: Boost Genuine Amazon Reviews
opportunities.description: I need support increasing the number of authentic reviews on a single ASIN in my Amazon store. To stay fully within Amazon policy, I only want to leverage the built-in “Request a Review” button inside Seller Central—no external messaging, no incentives, and no grey-area tactics. Here’s what I expect: • Identify every recent eligible order for the chosen product and trigger the Request a Review action at the appropriate timing (5–30 days post-delivery). • Keep a simple log showing the date each request was sent so I can track performance. • Advise me on a light workflow or automation that will let me continue this process after the project ends. Success will be measured by the successful submission of review requests for all eligible orders during the engagement period and receipt of your activity log. If you already use tools that can streamline this task and still keep it 100 % Amazon-compliant, let me know in your proposal.

opportunities.title: Cross-Platform Hospital Tycoon Game
opportunities.description: ATTENTION: PLEASE ENSURE YOU READ THE PROJECT REQUIREMENTS AND UNDERSTAND THE ASSETS ART. ANY BOT BID WILL AUTOMATICALLY BE REJECTED Seem this platform doesnt have anyone that have enough ability to prove their skills..... ------ >To be verified your ability to work: Please make a prototype demo video and send to me through chat. ANY BID WITHOUT PROOF OF PROTOTYPE WOULD BE REJECTED.. Thank you. --------- I want to turn the pixel-art pack at https://gainpips.itch.io/hospital-staff-patients into a full mobile hospital-management tycoon for both Android and iPhone/iPad. The art set should be used exactly as it is, so the code and UI need to respect its scale, palette, and proportions. Core gameplay revolves around three intertwined loops: players build and expand new hospital rooms, hire and schedule doctors, nurses, and other staff, then treat incoming patients while continually upgrading equipment to keep satisfaction and profits rising. Smooth drag-and-drop room placement, incremental unlocking of facilities, and clear resource dashboards are essential to make that flow satisfying on touch screens. I am happy with any well-documented engine—Unity, Godot, or a comparable cross-platform framework—as long as performance is solid on mid-range phones. Deliverables • Playable builds: Android APK + iOS TestFlight/IPA • Complete, compile-ready project source with comments • Brief setup guide so I can open, tweak, and export future versions myself Acceptance criteria will be a fully functional tutorial level that demonstrates room construction, staff hiring, and at least one diagnosis-treatment-discharge cycle while keeping the original asset visuals intact.

opportunities.title: Build Production Multi-Agent AI System
opportunities.description: We are looking for a senior (Principal / Staff+ level) engineer to architect, build, secure and operate production-grade autonomous multi-agent AI systems. This is a long-term engagement on real production systems with real uptime requirements, not a chatbot, demo or no-code automation. WHAT YOU WILL BUILD • Multi-agent systems with planner, executor, supervisor, worker and critic agents (LangGraph or custom) • Event-driven, durable workflows that run for hours or days and recover from any failure (Temporal, Celery, Kafka, NATS) • Inference and model-routing infrastructure optimized for cost and latency (vLLM, Ray, OpenAI and Anthropic APIs) • Persistent memory and advanced retrieval: Postgres, Redis, pgvector, Neo4j, Graph RAG, hybrid search • Tool and enterprise integrations via MCP and APIs (Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, Oracle, Workday) • Human-in-the-loop controls: escalation, approvals, confidence thresholds and override • Evaluation, monitoring and audit logging for every agent decision (LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana) • Deployment on Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform across AWS, Azure or GCP REQUIREMENTS • Proven experience building and operating autonomous or multi-agent systems in real production • Ability to own the full system: architecture, infrastructure, deployment, security, evaluation and reliability • Strong distributed systems skills: idempotency, retries, replay, backpressure, fault tolerance • Security-first approach: prompt injection, tool abuse, memory poisoning and access control • Deep async Python (asyncio, concurrency, queues) • Experience setting and meeting reliability targets (SLOs) for latency, uptime and cost • Production integration experience with at least two of Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, Oracle or Workday • Able to work independently without a technical lead PLEASE DO NOT BID IF Your main experience is chatbot wrappers, simple RAG apps, Streamlit demos, no-code workflows or prompt engineering only. opportunities.title: Airbnb & rooming house Property VA Needed
opportunities.description: I run a small portfolio of shared rooms and whole-home Airbnb listings across Melbourne and I need a steady pair of hands to take over day-to-day guest and resident communications. You will have full control of all messages, bookings, and follow-ups so that every enquiry is answered promptly and every stay runs smoothly. Key flow of work • Monitor and reply to Airbnb, email, Flatmates.com.au, and Facebook messages throughout the Melbourne day and evening. • Issue check-in details, handle reservation changes, leave thoughtful reviews, and keep occupancy calendars tidy. • Coordinate cleaners between stays and schedule regular gardening so properties stay guest-ready. • Arrange room inspections, log repairs in our shared Google Sheet, chase up trades, and send polite rent reminders. If an urgent problem arises—lockout, leak, or anything affecting safety—call or message me first before taking action so we can decide the next step together. The ideal fit writes clear, friendly English, knows their way around the Airbnb host dashboard, and is available 7 days per week for quick responses (about 15–20 hours spread across the week). Reliability is critical, so we will start with a paid trial and roll into an ongoing arrangement once we see a good rhythm. All records live in Google Sheets and most coordination happens in WhatsApp and email, so you will need a solid internet connection and the discipline to keep everything up to date. If you can bring that level of care, I look forward to working with you long term.

opportunities.title: 3D Browser Remake of Video Game
opportunities.description: I need a faithful 3D recreation of the entire game shown in this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Igh4QhpT81w. Every feature, level, mechanic, and character that appears there has to make it into the browser version so players feel as if they are stepping straight into a three-dimensional copy of the original. Platform The game must run smoothly inside a modern web browser—no installs, just click-to-play. A WebGL export from Unity or an equivalent HTML5 framework such as Three.js or Babylon.js is fine, provided performance remains solid on standard desktop machines. Visual & Audio Fidelity All characters, environments, animations, UI elements, and sound effects should match the video as closely as legally possible. Where assets need to be rebuilt from scratch, keep proportions, colors, and timing identical so returning players instantly recognize every detail. Core Expectations • Full gameplay loop, including every power-up, enemy pattern, scoring rule, and level transition • Responsive controls mapped for keyboard (WASD/arrow keys) and mouse where appropriate • Consistent frame rate at typical desktop resolutions • Clean, maintainable code and clearly organized project files Deliverables 1. Playable Web build hosted on a test URL 2. Complete source project (Unity, Three.js, or similar) with all assets and documentation 3. opportunities.title: Textured GLB Mesh for 3DVista
opportunities.description: I have both E57 and LAS point-clouds of a site with several building that I want to turn into a 3D digital twin inside 3DVista. What I need from you is a single GLB that contains a fully textured 3D mesh generated from the entire scan area—not just key rooms or simplified objects. Visual fidelity should be balanced: detailed enough to look good during standard walkthroughs in 3DVista, yet light enough to keep navigation smooth on typical desktop hardware. You are free to use your preferred workflow—RealityCapture, Blender, CloudCompare, MeshLab, or similar—as long as the result opens flawlessly in 3DVista with textures properly referenced. Deliverable • One GLB file, texture-packed, covering the full scan area, optimized for smooth viewing in 3DVista.

opportunities.title: Hiring One Elite Full-Service Marketing Agency – Six Business Ventures, One Long-Term Strategic Partnership
opportunities.description: HIRING ONE ELITE FULL-SERVICE MARKETING AGENCY SIX BUSINESS VENTURES | ONE MARKETING PARTNER | LONG-TERM STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP We are seeking ONE exceptional, highly experienced, full-service marketing company to manage marketing, branding, advertising, lead generation, and business development across six ventures. We require an established agency with a proven track record, a multidisciplinary team, and the resources to execute sophisticated campaigns across multiple industries. This is a long-term opportunity for the right marketing company. OUR SIX BUSINESS VENTURES 01 STEEL ONE https://steelone.us - Corporate branding and market positioning - B2B lead generation and digital advertising - Strategic partnerships, customer acquisition, and business development 02 SPRINTER https://sprinter-3364.vercel.app/ - Brand development and market positioning - Customer acquisition, digital campaigns, and lead generation - Strategic business growth 03 CONCORD PACIFIC INVESTMENTS https://concord-pacific-investments.vercel.app/ - Corporate and investment-sector marketing - Investor-oriented brand positioning and qualified prospect generation - Corporate visibility and strategic business relationships - All investment-related marketing must comply with applicable advertising and securities regulations 04 PARADISE CASTING https://paradise-casting.vercel.app/ - Brand awareness and market expansion - Targeted digital advertising and social media marketing - Audience and customer acquisition, strategic partnerships, and lead generation 05 SMARTMAT™ — INNOVATIVE SMART HOME TECHNOLOGY SmartMat™ - A Smarter, Safer Home SmartMat™ is an innovative smart doormat concept combining home security, connectivity, convenience, and entertainment. Features presented include a built-in security camera, live video and two-way communication, voice interaction, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, smartphone integration, music and audio, an integrated speaker, and heat/smoke detection with early fire alerts. - Develop a comprehensive product launch strategy and consumer brand recognition - Identify target markets, distributors, and retail or commercial partners - Create product demonstrations, promotional videos, and digital advertising - Build e-commerce, customer acquisition, and prelaunch demand-generation campaigns - Support national and international expansion The agency should demonstrate experience in consumer products, smart home technology, electronics, or technology startups. Safety, fire-detection, and security claims must be verified before publication. 06 MASTER CRAFT INTERNATIONAL https://master-craft-international.vercel.app/ - Corporate marketing strategy and professional brand positioning - Target market identification, digital advertising, SEO, and lead generation - Customer acquisition, strategic partnerships, and business development - Review the company's website, products, and services before proposing a tailored strategy CENTRALIZED MARKETING MANAGEMENT ONE agency must manage ALL SIX ventures under ONE master agreement. - One dedicated senior account director and complete professional marketing team - Individual strategies for each business with centralized coordination - Paid media, SEO, social media, content, brand development, and public relations - B2B/B2C lead generation, product commercialization, CRM, and automation - Separate, transparent budgets for each venture - Weekly updates and monthly executive performance reports AGENCY QUALIFICATIONS - Preferably 10+ years of professional marketing experience - Established company with a qualified, multidisciplinary team - Proven management of multiple brands or business accounts - Strong U.S. market expertise and international capabilities - Successful corporate and consumer campaigns, including new product launches - Verifiable case studies, client references, and acquisition results - Advanced digital advertising, conversion optimization, and reporting expertise Individual freelancers and inexperienced agencies are not suitable for this engagement. REQUIRED 90-DAY ACTION PLAN Days 1–30 | Research & Strategy - Audit all six ventures, websites, and existing marketing assets - Research markets, competitors, and target customers - Develop tailored strategies, budgets, and measurable KPIs Days 31–60 | Implementation - Launch approved advertising and lead-generation campaigns - Begin SEO, content, conversion, and brand-awareness initiatives - Prepare SmartMat™ product-launch marketing and centralized reporting Days 61–90 | Optimization & Growth - Analyze campaign performance and optimize spend and lead quality - Assess acquisition costs and campaign return on investment - Present a six-month growth plan for the portfolio FINANCIAL PROPOSAL Submit competitive pricing with agency management fees and advertising expenditures quoted separately. - Total monthly agency management fee covering all six ventures - Recommended advertising budget for each venture - Initial setup costs, implementation fees, and assigned personnel - Optional performance-based compensation and proposed contract terms - Estimated implementation schedule APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS - Company profile: name, website, location, years in operation, and team size - Relevant experience managing multiple brands and complex campaigns - At least three verifiable case studies with measurable results - Initial assessment of all six ventures and their marketing opportunities - Proposed cross-portfolio strategy and operating structure - SmartMat™ experience in product launches, electronics, or smart home technology - Dedicated account director and assigned specialists - Detailed financial proposal, KPI framework, and client references OUR OBJECTIVE We seek a sophisticated marketing partner capable of supporting the growth and commercialization of multiple businesses. We expect professionalism, creativity, accountability, strategic execution, and measurable results. The selected agency will work with executive management and may receive additional ventures as our portfolio expands. ONE AGENCY. SIX BUSINESS VENTURES. ONE CENTRALIZED MARKETING TEAM. ONE LONG-TERM PARTNERSHIP. ONLY ESTABLISHED, HIGHLY EXPERIENCED, FULL-SERVICE MARKETING COMPANIES SHOULD APPLY. Generic proposals will not be considered.

opportunities.title: Virtual Personal Assistant Needed (USA Applicants Only)
opportunities.description: My calendar fills up fast, and my inbox follows suit, so I’m bringing in a virtual assistant who can keep both under control while helping with day-to-day research and bookings. Here’s the core of what you’ll handle: • Calendar & appointments – block, reschedule, and send invites with priority given to work meetings and deadlines. I use Google Calendar and Microsoft Teams, so you’ll work inside those tools. • Inbox & messages – triage daily mail in Gmail, draft replies for my approval, flag anything time-sensitive, and archive the noise. • Research & bookings – find data or service options I ask for (flights, hotel rooms, vendor quotes, quick market facts) and complete the booking or prep a short brief. Requirement: This position is open exclusively to applicants within the USA. Access & workflow You’ll have delegated access that lets you draft but not send emails without my OK. For messages, a shared Slack channel or WhatsApp chat will keep quick questions moving. Success looks like a clean inbox at the end of each day, a calendar that never double-books, and well-documented research ready when I need it. If you’re organized, responsive, and comfortable with Google Workspace, Outlook, Zoom, and standard travel-booking sites—and you're based in the USA—I’d love to hear how you’d approach this.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40783663, publicado hace 12 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 15 - 25.
